[/p][p][/p][p]Here's what's been happening:[/p][p]- Screen Australia due date [/p][list][*][p]My due date for Screen Australia was coming closer, but I still had a lot to do[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43180392/936c50d80f43dba673ec02fb37ccdeeea40b2622.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]- Wrote the prototype content [/p][list][*][p]I revised my 2017 Webtoon Canvas to adapt its story for the game[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43180392/81cef00aebd6106b4a9e5c32df51b6c505a48a2e.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]- Planned the cutscenes[/p][list][*][p]I then made rough storyboards to help plan the cutscenes
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43180392/3c89bbecb4701bd839767d7863bd5034ba5f4f33.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]- Drew lots for 2D cutscenes [/p][list][*][p]Then I drew lots and lots and lots and looooooooots[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43180392/cc71fbc60a2fa178df2d78829189b13663a76967.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]- 3D cutscene animation [/p][list][*][p]Then I made some animations for some 3D cutscenes [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43180392/af6cc7c445e4dd09f476efb961f2105017f0aa07.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]- Made anime-style expressions [/p][list][*][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43180392/bb3c37aaa5838291049624cf0c0c1c943246a282.jpg"][/img]  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43180392/87ee31c535a5881b74d8f65560bf2d654d67ac4e.jpg"][/img]  [/p][/*][/list][p]- Fixed Jobs System code [/p][p]- Drew some custom icons [/p][list][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43180392/cbcd406d38bd2202451c4a386381101ce2914ca3.jpg"][/img]  [/p][/*][/list][p]- Added 30+ mins of gameplay [/p][list][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43180392/9dc136fac883c412fbc2ac49298ce93470253dd8.jpg"][/img]  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]- Unity lagged again [/p][p]- Fixed built game lighting bug [/p][p]- Prepare for closed playtesting [/p][list][*][p]Steam Playtest page and keys are ready![/p][/*][*][p]I just have to wait for Screen Australia to approve the prototype for use in the playtest[/p][/*][/list][p]- Playtest sign-up[/p][list][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43180392/70fd542c1657b6656652bb099b4cd04d4df84ddc.jpg"][/img]  [/p][/*][*][p]Sign-up link:   [url="https://inunekonanita.com/#newsletter"]https://inunekonanita.com/#newsletter[/url][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43180392/87f50fb2697f8d6af1accc6a82ac7fb5e39b3cb4.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Stay safe, happy and healthy!
